description: This file defines a service class 'NoSlotsNotificationService' that handles notifications when no slots are available for an event. It manages Redis keys, checks organization settings, and sends email notifications to team admins when certain conditions are met.

classes.name: NoSlotsNotificationService
classes.description: A service class that manages notifications for no available slots, including Redis key management, organization setting checks, and email notifications to admins.

methods.name: handleNotificationWhenNoSlots
methods.description: Handles the process of notifying team admins when no slots are available for an event, including Redis operations and email dispatch.
